name: bigin-ba-workflow-plugin
description: Guides a BA through turning raw communication into structured requirement documentation: project initiation, intake, signal extraction, use-case and business-rule drafting behind a written review gate, a per-feature check that the resulting use cases actually add up, approval, entity sync, a verified UX design spec, an on-request Open Design render that fans out one run per feature and assembles them into one interactive prototype, and business-only epics and user stories sliced from approved use cases plus a frozen prototype snapshot. Since v1.12.0 a deterministic engine (bin/bigin) does every bookkeeping write — change sets applied once, a ledger for gated changes, hub tables regenerated by script — while agents only make judgements and return JSON; supports communication and codebase intake.
